title: Reintentar verificación runtime del mapa V12 con capacidad browser canónica
mission: Execute the existing Jose Study V12 map-refinement LAB candidate in a representative JavaScript browser, verify the pinned V11 SHA gate, enter a topic-local map, capture rail/level/round evidence and exercise the V12/V11 A/B toggle without modifying or promoting product authority.
definition_of_done: Run the existing V12 LAB candidate in a representative JavaScript browser.
Observe and record the V11 SHA-256 gate result before using the candidate.
Enter at least one topic-local map and record rail, level and round counts.
Exercise V12/V11 A/B and confirm V11 remains intact.
Record runtime evidence; do not infer PASS from static source and do not promote Current/Human Accepted/Served.
